name: Yuri no Hana Sanjuusou ~Watashi Dake no Idol~
original_name: 百合の花三重奏～私だけのアイドル～
source:
Hinako Kounosu and Marimo Kondou were classmates. They both listened to the same radio program every night.
One day, the two girls could not withhold their feeling and crossed the line.
Then another girl appeared in their life.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE054927.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
鴻巢雏子与近藤まりも是同班同学，每晚都会收听同一个广播节目。
某天，两名女孩再也抑制不住彼此的感情，终于越过了那条界线。
随后，第三名少女出现在她们的生活中。

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE054927.html]DLsite English[/url]]
